# MyAnya – Structured English Learning

We build tools and paths for self-taught English learners. No endless chatbots. No streak theatre. A clear map from A0 to C1.

If you learn English at a kitchen table after work, you know the problem. Free English learning resources are scattered. Apps push streaks. Open chat keeps you busy but never tells you what to study next. We built something quieter: a structured English course you can follow at your own pace.

## Pin this first

- **[english-myanya-learning-resources](https://github.com/chyzhique/english-myanya-learning-resources)** — Free guides: English for beginners, English grammar, English vocabulary, English conversation, English speaking practice, British English pronunciation, and an English study plan. Start here for a usable English learning path.

## Philosophy

- **A course. Not a chat.** Structure beats endless tap-and-talk.
- Kitchen-table English. Short sentences. Real phrases for shops, neighbours, and work.
- British English lean where it helps life in Europe.
- Production first: you speak or write something specific, then fix one or two mistakes.

## The guided path

[MyAnya.app - The Guided Path](https://myanya.app)

A course. Not a chat. You try. Anya checks your writing and speaking. Soft structure from A0 onward — self-paced English course energy, without the fluff.
